limitations: CP27 allocations are finite mixed-fixture physical measurements; transferred bytes/event are assumptions, not current marginal slopes or bounds. Generic receipts gained four inline fields in064/065.
Initial shared full catalog is counted once; recurring content excludes observation/head allocation. Daily successful catalog versions cause roster-link epochs even with identical catalog content.
Whole candidate core replaces old AB/core/proof/link/standings rates. Synthetic controls are diagnostic only; ordinary controls have their own charge and unresolved costs.
Raw/content proxy is charged on every declared transition, including a return to prior content; this can overallow deduplicated content but avoids treating transition observations as free.
Startup uses historical attributable noncatalog seed once; excludes classified nonDATA and does not add candidate warmup/setup again. Current startup differences remain unresolved.
